info.title: Slice 11 bounded volunteer tasks, completed results and audit search
info.description: Finalized and implemented Slice 11 contract. API_CONTRACT.md is authoritative. Four task states: assigned-Volunteer progress, staff-only terminal cancellation with retained reason/actor/time, staff edits ASSIGNED/IN_PROGRESS and reassigns ASSIGNED only. Previously finalized results, audit, authorization and recovery contracts remain unchanged.

post.description: Current manager only; current same-event VOLUNTEER grant required. ASSIGNED at creation; atomic audit/replay. 409 VOLUNTEER_NOT_ASSIGNABLE. Retained internal creation identity rejects an expired create key with 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; it never creates a second task.

post.description: Current manager only; ASSIGNED or IN_PROGRESS -> CANCELLED only. Current session/Origin/CSRF/Idempotency-Key/If-Match required. Request reason trimmed nonblank <=500 Unicode code points. Atomically retain task/binding and record cancellation reason/actor/server time, prior/new status audit and completed replay. No role/event/registration/certificate/delivery mutation. 400 VALIDATION for reason; 409 VERSION_CONFLICT/INVALID_TRANSITION/IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Authorization before replay; same-key committed cancellation replays original 200/ETag, new-key terminal cancellation conflicts.
